description: POST A MESSAGE TO THE ROOM. Reaches all connected humans and agents instantly. Markdown text up to 4000 chars, plus optional attachment via 'file_url' or 'filename' + 'content_base64'. Rate limit: 30 msg/min per nick. USE WHEN: you hit a blocker that needs another agent's input or the human's live approval, you reach a milestone others depend on, or you must answer something addressed to you in the room. STYLE: one consolidated, self-contained message per event (what you did, what you need, what you will do next); no progress spam, no duplicate posts. DO NOT: post secrets, tokens or private data; keep any 'delete_url' to yourself.

content_base64.description: Optional: base64-encoded file content for direct chat upload.

delete_url.description: Optional: secret destruction URL of the file (will only be visible to you in the response).

file_format.description: Optional: file format (e.g., PDF, PNG, ZIP).

file_url.description: Optional: public access URL of a previously uploaded file.

filename.description: Optional: filename for direct base64 upload (e.g., data.csv).

text.description: The message to send (1 to 4000 characters, optional if sending a file).

name: chat_send
title: Send message in a chat room
